title: An Exhaustively Measured Benchmark for Multi-Objective Neural Architecture Search in Text Generation
description:
Benchmark table, exact Pareto fronts, run manifests, cost artifact and analysis code for an exhaustive census of a DistilGPT2-derived design space. All 1,099 architectures were trained to an identical budget of 100 million tokens under one protocol, which makes the Pareto front over held-out perplexity, parameter count and key-value cache size exact rather than estimated.

The analysis code and the data it reads are archived in the same revision, so any result can be recomputed against the measurements it came from.
